name: Ristretto
steps: Warm four small cups and prepare a clean espresso basket. Use freshly ground coffee suited to your machine.
Dose approximately 9 g ground coffee for each single basket, distribute it evenly and tamp level. Do not exceed the basket’s rated dose.
Extract each shot for approximately 20–25 seconds, targeting about 20 ml in the cup; stop by yield rather than allowing the water to run indefinitely.
If flow gushes out, use a finer grind next time; if it barely flows, use a slightly coarser grind. Change one variable at a time.
Serve the four shots immediately, preparing sequentially if your machine has one group head.
tips: Machine, roast and basket size affect extraction; the stated yield is a starting point.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
